description: A command-line tool for parsing and analyzing NTFS metadata, specifically the Master File Table (MFT). It supports various operations such as exporting files, displaying directory contents, and extracting security descriptors.

usage_examples.description: Displays detailed information about the security descriptor with ID 256.
Generates a CSV file with detailed information including DOS filenames.
Exports the file record at offset 679 to a specified directory.

switches.name: --de
switches.description: Dumps full details of a specific entry number.

switches.name: --dr
switches.description: Dumps all resident files within the MFT to a specified directory.

switches.name: --ds
switches.description: Provides detailed information about the specified security descriptor.

switches.name: --fl
switches.description: Outputs a simple file listing with specific columns.

switches.name: --at
switches.description: Displays timestamps even when they are identical.

switches.name: --rs
switches.description: Attempts to recover slack space from FILE records.

related_tools.name: MFTECmd$J$MFTParser.ps1
related_tools.description: A PowerShell script for parsing and analyzing MFT, JFR, and $SDS records.
